nature.title: 1. Nature of the Fan-Made Project
nature.p1: This portal website is an unofficial fan-made project created with love by the community to support and appreciate VTuber / Content Creator Purin Kokoa.
nature.p2: This website is completely non-commercial, not officially affiliated with management or agencies, and generates no direct commercial profit.

copyright.title: 2. Copyright & Character Ownership
copyright.p1: All intellectual property rights regarding characters, VTuber 2D/3D model designs, names, voice recordings, and live stream content are the sole property of Purin Kokoa and/or official creators.
copyright.p2: Illustrations, fanarts, and media assets displayed across this portal are credited to their original creators and used strictly for fan community promotion.

takedown.title: 3. Content Takedown & Modification Requests
takedown.p1: If you are a copyright owner or official representative and wish to request modification or removal of specific assets or information, please contact the developer team via GitHub or community channels.
